card.name: The letters CE as an abbreviation
card.fires_on: The letters "CE" (or "ce") used as an abbreviation. It appears after a drug dose (conjugated estrogens) or after a year (Common Era), and sometimes at the start of cefdinir.

modes.label: Conjugated estrogens

modes.description: CE or C.E. right after a year or in a date range.

modes.label: Start of cefdinir
modes.description: CE as the opening letters of an all-caps drug name in an antibiotic table.
modes.example: 7 mg/kg q12h 10 days<< CE>>FDINIR FOR ORAL SUSP
